stories.title: The Sift, Minecraft's first new dimension in 15 years
stories.summary: At Minecraft Live, Mojang showed The Sift, a pink and teal world with a bunny mob, and the first new dimension coming to the main game in almost 15 years. The first-look screenshot got 236K likes. It appears first in Minecraft Dungeons II and comes to Java and Bedrock in 2027. Players named the bunny the "blub".
